description: This file defines an interface `JsonObject` representing an immutable JSON object with methods for creation, manipulation, retrieval, and querying of JSON data structures within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject from a JSON string.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for constructing JsonObject instances.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with this JSON object for modifications.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a field with a specific value type (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue) and returns a new JsonObject.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field based on a JsonFieldDefinition or a JsonField and returns a new JsonObject.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple fields provided as Iterable<JsonField> and returns a new JsonObject.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the JSON object contains a field at the specified key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a subset of the object hierarchy at the specified JsonPointer or JsonFieldDefinition or JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key as an Optional<JsonValue>.

methods.name: getValue(JsonFieldDefinition)
methods.description: Retrieves the typed value at the location specified by a JsonFieldDefinition, if present.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves the typed value at the location specified by a JsonFieldDefinition or throws if missing.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a field specified by a key or JSON pointer, returning a new JsonObject.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of keys in the JSON object.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns an Optional<JsonField> containing key and value for a given key.
